text:
infra-oncall: @channel north-ops alert — control-plane in north1 is failing to apply route/config rollouts. multiple teams seeing 403s in console and service routing not updating. GPU autoscaler not reacting. rolling this to incidents.

sarah: seeing authz errors from mgmtplane: `ERROR authz: failed to fetch policy: 502` across control-plane pods. console requests hit oauth proxy and get 502/403 intermittently.

james: confirmed. deploys into north1 are stuck in 'applying configs' state. routing table update requests queue and then timeout. CLI shows 504 from config-sync.

michelle: GPU pool metrics show nodes healthy but provisioner not attaching workloads: `provisioner: attach_timeout` spikes. maybe control-plane couldn't sign tokens for kube-provisioner.

leo: any recent cert rotations or KMS ops? saw a KMS job earlier today from infra-automation.

infra-oncall: @sarah @james @michelle FYI there was a key-rotation job at 08:12 UTC. I'm checking rotation logs now.

sarah: rotation logs show partial success — 2/3 control-plane replicas updated, one failed with `certificate chain validation error`. That instance is returning 502 for auth requests.

james: okay that aligns. config-sync is quorum-dependent; with the replica failing rollout the leader election is flapping. need to either force a config push to remaining nodes or fail over the control-plane.

michelle: traffic shift options: 1) shift routing traffic to west2 (standby) via global router with `kubectl patch routetable` 2) promote existing standby control-plane in west2 to primary (longer, requires db snap). Which do we want?

leo: prefer traffic shift first — faster. but routing API requires signed token from control-plane. if auth tokens are impacted, router can't change policies.

infra-oncall: running manual route update using admin bypass token. attempting:

```
# attempt to update routetable to prefer west2
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_BYPASS" https://global-router.internal/api/v1/routetables/north1/shift -d '{"prefer":"west2","drain":true}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy job 6248 queued, attempted 3 retries and failed: `deploy-bot: cannot retrieve auth token: 502 from auth-service`

sarah: admin-bypass accepted but router returned `403 forbidden` for route write. looks like ACL checks still delegated to control-plane for validation.

james: backup plan: take the unhealthy control-plane replica out of the cluster (cordon + remove from leader election) so quorum forms with 2/2. can someone run the cordon script? `scripts/maintenance/evict-controlplane.sh north1 cp-3`

michelle: I'm running it now. patching etcd member list, cordoning cp-3.

infra-oncall: cp-3 cordoned. waiting for election. observing logs:

```
leader-election: switching leader from cp-3 -> cp-1
config-sync: resuming, applying pending rollouts
```

leo: seeing config-sync progress. console auth responses improving (200s) for a subset of requests. GPU autoscaler caught up and attached 8 pending pods.

sarah: still seeing intermittent 403s for some tenant routes — likely cached invalid tokens. recommend cache invalidate on auth-proxy: `POST /admin/cache/invalidate` for oauth-proxy in north1.

james: cache invalidation triggered. also triggered a partial traffic drain for the oldest sessions to force reauth.

infra-oncall: auth-proxy caches cleared. monitoring: console 200 rate up to 98%, routing update queue drained. GPU pool utilization normalized from 76% to 58% as workloads resumed.

michelle: leaving a post-incident task: investigate why KMS rotation didn't update cp-3 cert chain cleanly, add preflight checks to rotation job, and a runway for manual eviction documented under runbook.

leo: noted. I'll open a ticket and tag security/KMS.

sarah: adding notes: start time 1718245678, mitigated 1718245693. impact: north1 console auth and config rollouts degraded, brief GPU provisioning stalls, no data loss.

infra-oncall: thanks everyone. closing thread into postmortem. :white_check_mark:
